parsed.translation_en: I got rhinoplasty from Dr. Kim Do-hyun at Seoul Mirae Plastic Surgery 😊 The cost was 3,500,000 KRW (350만원), and they were really kind from the consultation all the way through the surgery. The swelling lasted about 2 weeks, and now I'm at 3 months and the line looks so natural!! Highly recommend 👍

I got rhinoplasty from Dr. Kim Do-hyun at Seoul Mirae Plastic Surgery. The cost was 3,500,000 KRW (350만원), and they were really kind from the consultation all the way through the surgery.
The swelling lasted about 2 weeks, and now I'm at 3 months and the line looks so natural!! Highly recommend ✨✨

I got non-incisional (buried suture) double eyelid surgery at Mirae Plastic Surgery, and it cost 1,200,000 KRW (120만원). Dr. Lee Su-jin performed it, but one side feels like it has come slightly undone, so I booked a revision consultation. The aftercare was just so-so.

This is my review of square-jaw + cheekbone facial contouring surgery at Seoul Mirae PS. It was 12,000,000 KRW (1200만원) in total. Dr. Park Jung-woo's skill is the best! This post is a sponsored-experience review written with a manuscript fee provided by the clinic.

I did a 10-session Pico toning package at Dalbit Dermatology. It's 80,000 KRW (8만원) per session, 800,000 KRW (80만원) in total. My melasma has definitely faded, and there was almost no downtime, so I went straight back to work 🙌

I had incisional double eyelid surgery with Dr. Choi Min-ho at Haneulbit Plastic Surgery. The price was 1,800,000 KRW (180만원), the line is crisp, and the scar is barely visible. Next I plan to get under-eye fat repositioning here too.

I had revision rhinoplasty with Dr. Jung Ha-eun at Sorin Plastic Surgery. It was 5,500,000 KRW (550만원); they removed the silicone and used costal (rib) cartilage. I'm only 1 month in, so there's still some swelling, but I'm satisfied. However, the waiting time was way too long 😢
I got Mulgwang (hydrating skin booster) injections and Rejuran at Grace View Clinic in Gangnam. I paid 450,000 KRW (45만원), and my skin texture has become moist. This post may earn a small commission.
